TABLE.NAME: report_transcript_issue
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per issued transcript: the verification code and a snapshot of the rows exactly as they were issued.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner the transcript is about.

FIELD.NAME: issuerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who triggered the issue. Equals userid for a self-download; 0 once that user has been deleted.

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: Verification code, unique, from an unambiguous upper-case alphabet.

FIELD.NAME: documenttitle
FIELD.COMMENT: The document title setting at issue time.

FIELD.NAME: snapshot
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: the rows as rendered plus the settings that shaped them.

TABLE.NAME: report_transcript_archive
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per learner per course, holding what a transcript line needs so that the line survives the course being deleted.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course as it was; the course row may no longer exist.

FIELD.NAME: coursename
FIELD.COMMENT: Formatted full name, captured so it renders without the course.

FIELD.NAME: idnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Kept for the site's own reporting; the transcript line does not show it.

FIELD.NAME: categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: So that the excluded-categories setting still applies once the course is gone.

FIELD.NAME: categorypath
FIELD.COMMENT: Slash delimited ancestor ids ending with the course category, so an excluded ancestor still matches after the categories themselves are deleted.

FIELD.NAME: categoryname
FIELD.COMMENT: Kept for the site's own reporting; the transcript line does not show it.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: A grade_presenter STATUS_ constant: completed, inprogress or untracked.

FIELD.NAME: gradetext
FIELD.COMMENT: The grade as it was displayed, or the not-available dash.

FIELD.NAME: hidden
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the gradebook was withholding the grade at capture.
